## What's Changed
* Analyse repositories from several organisations at once by @adampeterhiggins in https://github.com/adampeterhiggins/github-monitor/pull/15
* Build release-local in its own worktree, off the branch, as setgist does. by @adampeterhiggins in https://github.com/adampeterhiggins/github-monitor/pull/16
* Track a user account's repositories alongside organisations by @adampeterhiggins in https://github.com/adampeterhiggins/github-monitor/pull/17
* Add an organisation filter beside the repository filter by @adampeterhiggins in https://github.com/adampeterhiggins/github-monitor/pull/18
* Add search and filters to the Settings repository list by @adampeterhiggins in https://github.com/adampeterhiggins/github-monitor/pull/19
* Turn the Settings repository filters into checkbox lists by @adampeterhiggins in https://github.com/adampeterhiggins/github-monitor/pull/20
* Build worktrees out of their own way, so they stay small and T3 Code can clean them up by @adampeterhiggins in https://github.com/adampeterhiggins/github-monitor/pull/21
* Add a per-day view to the Contributors timeline by @adampeterhiggins in https://github.com/adampeterhiggins/github-monitor/pull/22
* Separate cumulative from the chart's time period by @adampeterhiggins in https://github.com/adampeterhiggins/github-monitor/pull/23
* Match daily commits to GitHub's weekly stats by @adampeterhiggins in https://github.com/adampeterhiggins/github-monitor/pull/24
* Track PR associations and filter contributor commits by @adampeterhiggins in https://github.com/adampeterhiggins/github-monitor/pull/25


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/adampeterhiggins/github-monitor/compare/v0.2.5...v0.2.14
